claim:
Text: "BJP MP Kirron Kher Said "Rape Is A Part Of Indian Culture And It Can't Be Stopped""
Claim date: October 15, 2020
before_justification: The fact‑check concludes that BJP MP [Kirron Kher](https://indianexpress.com/about/kirron-kher/) did **not** make the statement attributed to her; her actual [2018 remarks](https://m.timesofindia.com/times-fact-check/news/fake-alert-bjp-mp-kirron-kher-didnt-say-rape-is-part-of-indian-culture/articleshow/78687624.cms) demanded capital punishment for rapists and stressed the need to change societal mindsets, while the viral claim was traced to a [manipulated graphic](https://www.indiatoday.in/fact-check/story/fact-check-kirron-kher-didn-t-say-rapes-cannot-be-stopped-as-it-s-part-of-our-culture-1731299-2020-10-13) from a source known for misinformation. No credible sources or official records support the alleged quote, leading to a verdict of **refuted**.
after_justification: The fact-check confirms that BJP MP Kirron Kher made a public statement on October 15, 2020, with a [verified video](https://www.mensxp.com/tag/kirron-kher.html) showing her saying "Rape is part of our culture" during a television interview, as also reported by [multiple news organizations](https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-51969961). However, the evidence does not support the additional phrase "and it can't be stopped" included in the original claim. Since the claim presents a specific combined quote and only a portion is verified, the fact-check concludes the claim is **refuted**.

adopted_qa_evidence.answer: Yes, BJP MP Kirron Kher made a public statement on October 15, 2020, in which she stated that “rape is a part of Indian culture and it cannot be stopped,” as confirmed by multiple news reports.
